purpose: Permanently discharge the defect class found by independent audit CYCLE_39751745107 (gate REVISE, required_fixes D1-D6: evidence_refs_n/list-length mismatches, an invalid evidence-ref path, loss of the canonical two-space evidence_refs indentation, and promotion of unaudited run 39732040165 as ACCEPTED claim-bearing evidence). This instrument is a STATE-CLAIM gate, not a product measurement: it scores the lane's own state/report claim path, never a packet, never a frozen bar.

checks.rule: evidence_refs_n == len(evidence_refs). Any other value is an internally inconsistent metadata claim (audit fixes 1 and 2).

Every evidence_refs entry resolves to an existing FILE in the committed tree (first whitespace-delimited token, trailing comma stripped; directories do not count, matching the lane's long-standing test_evidence_refs_exist contract). Non-file refs are invalid provenance claims (audit fix 3, same class).
In the raw file, the line carrying the top-level "evidence_refs" key begins with exactly two spaces (canonical two-space indentation; audit fix 4).

For every block that carries a claim_bearing_run whose numeric run id is >= FROZED_PROMOTION_CUTOFF_RUN (inclusive), the block must EITHER name a run that has results/audit/evaluation/CYCLE_<run>_GATE.json in the committed tree, OR carry an explicit non-promotion disclosure: audit_status == 'PENDING_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT' or pending_independent_audit == true or accepted_as_evidence == false. Runs numerically below the cutoff are inventoried INFORMATIONALLY only and never fail this check: they are historical accepted/negative evidence preserved verbatim under AGENTS.md items 5-6 and predate this defect class. The cutoff is frozen here, before execution, to the exact run the audit named.
The state's accepted_run_id has results/audit/evaluation/CYCLE_<run>_GATE.json present in the committed tree.
accepted_run_id, direction_version and github_run are identical in the root control-plane state and the lane state (audit fix 6 reconciliation).

exit_codes.2: ENVIRONMENT_ERROR (a state file or the tree is unreadable; never a pass, never a fail)

non_claims: This gate does NOT re-score, move or re-derive any frozen absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bar; those stay REPORTED-ONLY and unmet on the v3 bytes.
This gate does NOT lift any accepted DO-NOT-SERVE order, certify packet admission, or claim the map helps a jurist.
This gate does NOT run any universal-174k benchmark.
This gate does NOT audit any measurement's numbers; it only checks the lane's state/report claim path for the six named defect classes.
